design.driver: onProgress keeps lastText and skips console.log when text is unchanged; after the run, driver writes progress.json (JSON.stringify of result.progress) and progress.txt (projectProgress text) into the evidence dir before the final status lines.
design.poller: In executeNode, when skillProgressRollupDir is set, start a 2s interval BEFORE the awaited invokeAdapter call: each tick calls findChildSkillProgress(dir, childRunId) and, if a record exists, rollupChildProgress({progressTracker, phaseId, nodeId, record}) - partial fractions (0<f<1) land on the active item and move plannedProgress; the interval is cleared in a finally after invokeAdapter resolves, and the existing post-return rollup remains as the final writer. Timer errors are swallowed like the existing rollup catch; no behavior change when skillProgressRollupDir is unset.
design.recorder: recordSkillProgress gains { percent } (0-100, default 100): percent 100 keeps today's terminal record; percent < 100 writes status active with milestones derived to hit the target: M1 complete (30) when percent >= 30; M2 active with fraction (percent-30)/40 clamped [0,1) when 30 < percent < 70; M3 pending below 70, active with fraction (percent-70)/30 at >= 70; the existing validator derives and enforces overallPercent. Hosts call it with partial percents between internal steps and 100 at completion.
design.telemetry: Add skill-progress-rollup to TELEMETRY_EVENT_TYPES and to the telemetry-event schema enum; regenerate the registry schemaContentDigest for csm-orchestrate-telemetry-event/1; validate a synthetic rollup event against the schema in a test.
design.tests: New orchestrate test file: (a) percentage-movement - host writes partial records on a timer mid-invocation; collect onProgress snapshots; assert rendered percentage values strictly increase and at least one mid-run snapshot differs from both first and last; (b) rollup telemetry appears in a captured jsonl transport; (c) driver E2E asserts progress.json/progress.txt exist and at least three distinct TASK PROGRESS texts were printed.
